items.html: And we now need to explain how the Yesod of ZA is corrected. For we have already explained that the first Tifferet and Yesod within him rose up and became the aspect of Daat and Tifferet; and if so, from where was the Yesod of ZA emanated? But the matter will be understood by what was said above, concerning the upper coupling of Arich Anpin, called the coupling of kisses, with which He coupled to give Mochin to Aba and Ima, and to add to them new NHY. And there we explained some of the matter, and here we shall expand it a little more.
